title: validate deterministic scheme matching
description: POST /api/v1/schemes/match with a complete valid citizen profile and verify the response includes eligible schemes, match percentages, benefits, and required documents. Also submit missing or conflicting eligibility fields and verify a 400 response with validation errors and no recommendations.

title: validate risk assessment and explanations
description: POST /api/v1/risk/assess-risk with a complete valid profile and verify the response contains a risk score, risk band, and explainable barrier contributions. Submit missing or malformed features and out-of-range numeric values, verifying the documented 422 or 400 validation responses and no prediction.

title: validate document analysis
description: POST /api/v1/documents/analyze with a supported readable document and verify OCR extraction, document insights, and pre-screening findings. Verify corrupted or unreadable files return 400 and unsupported formats return 415 without analysis output.

title: validate nearby kiosk search
description: GET /api/v1/kiosks/nearby with a valid district or pincode and verify the response lists matching kiosks with contact details and distances. Submit missing or invalid location filters and verify a 400 response with filter validation errors.

title: validate kiosk token booking
description: POST /api/v1/kiosks/book-token with valid kiosk and citizen details and verify a successful response contains an immutable appointment token and QR pass details. Submit incomplete booking data and verify a 422 response with validation errors.

title: validate kiosk appointment tracking
description: GET /api/v1/kiosks/track/{reference_id} with a valid booking reference and verify the current token or appointment status is returned. Use an unknown reference ID and verify a 404 response.

title: validate multilingual scheme chat
description: POST /api/v1/chat with a nonempty welfare question in a supported language and verify the response provides grounded scheme guidance with citations. Submit an empty message or unsupported language and verify a 400 response with input validation errors.

title: validate text to speech generation
description: POST /api/v1/chat/tts with valid assistant response text and verify synthesized audio is returned. Submit empty or overly long text and verify a 422 response with text-to-speech validation errors.

title: validate api setu verification
description: POST /api/v1/apisetu/verify with valid verification data and verify the response confirms integration readiness. Submit malformed data or invalid credentials and verify the appropriate 400 or 401 failure response.

title: validate api setu gateway status
description: GET /api/v1/apisetu/status and verify an available gateway returns 200 with status details. When the gateway is unavailable, verify the endpoint returns 503 with service unavailability information.
